data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and step sequence (open hotel search, type destination and pick a suggestion, choose dates, set rooms/guests, apply filters and sort), but it puts Search last when the true flow clicks it before the guests, filter and sort steps, and its filters (style, amenities, stars) don't match the true Distance filter and sort. It is also vague on the date picking and guest increments, so an automation would need some guesswork.
